creation.musicLyricsGuide: Nnyonnyola sitayiro n'eddoboozi mu kusaba kwo. Teeka ebigambo wansi wa tags wansi. Ggyako {{instrumental}} olw'amaloboozi.
creation.setupAllDownload: Wanula era otegeke buli kimu mu ngeri ey'otoma
creation.setupStorage: Fayiro zonna awamu: {{download}}. Okutereka: {{reserve}}. Ekifo ekirala ekyetaagisa: {{required}}. Ya bwereere ku drive erongooseddwa: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: Ebibulamu {{missing}}. Sumulula ekifo oba londa drive endala erimu storage emala.
creation.setupTextNote: Enkola endala ey’ebiwandiiko byokka mu mboozi, okuwandiika, ebikozesebwa n’okuddamu okutegekeddwa. Download: ebikwata ku {{size}}. Kyetaaga okujjukira okusinga {{defaultModel}} era tekikola ku bifaananyi oba amaloboozi gennyini. Okuddamu okwogerwa kukozesa eddoboozi ly’enkola. Kironde ku mirimu gy'ebiwandiiko ng'olina ekijjukizo ekimala. Kebera eby’okuddamu ebituufu n’ensonda.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M ekola ebifaananyi. Qwen3 ekola enkodi y’ennyonnyola, ate VAE efulumya ekifaananyi ekisembayo. Teekawo omugerageranyo gw’obugazi n’obuwanvu, obutangaavu bw’ekifaananyi, ensigo, emitendera n’okugaziya ekifaananyi. Ebisembebwa okutandika: 21:9, emitendera ena n’ensigo erondebwa mu butanwa.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo ekola omuziki ogutaliimu kuyimba oba ennyimba. Enteekateeka ekola ensengeka, jenereta ya 2B Q4_K_M ekola eddoboozi, enkoda y’ebiwandiiko ekola ku nnyinnyonnyola, ate VAE eggyayo eddoboozi lya stereo 48 kHz. Teekawo obudde, enkola ya fayiro y’amaloboozi, sipiidi y’omuziki, ebigambo by’oluyimba, olulimi, emitendera n’ensigo. Ebisembebwa: sekondi 30, emitendera munaana, WAV 24-bit n’ensigo erondebwa mu butanwa.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M ekola obutambi okuva mu nnyinnyonnyola. Ebisembebwa: sekondi ttaano, 21:9 ne 16 FPS. Teekawo obudde, omuwendo gw’ebifaananyi buli sekondi, obutangaavu, emitendera n’ensigo. Vidiyo empanvu egatta obutambi obumpi, era we bwegattira wayinza okulabika. · MP4: Python + imageio-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: Ewanula n'okusengeka ebikozesebwa ebisemba: LFM3-Omni + mmproj ku biwandiiko, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 okuggya ennimi nnyingi (CPU nga bwe kibadde), FLUX.2 Klein 4B n'ebitundu byayo okukola ebifaananyi, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×{4, ACE-Step ku muziki (Ekivuga nga kikoleddwa), ne Wan2.1 ku vidiyo. Kebera obunene bwa fayiro, ekifo ku disiki n’ebisaanyizo bya vidiyo wansi. Downloads ezenjawulo ne Browse zisigala nga ziriwo.
creation.videoDurationNote: Vidiyo empanvu zikuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu bitundu ebimpi. Okusala kuyinza okulabika era okuzaala kuyinza okutwala ekiseera ekiwanvu.
creation.videoModel: Ekitabo ky’ekyokulabirako kya vidiyo eky’omu kitundu
creation.configure: Londa model y'ekire n'ekisumuluzo kyayo ekya API, oba sengeka yingini y'ekitundu erongooseddwa ne fayiro zaayo ezeetaagisa mu nteekateeka z'Okutonda.
creation.localNote: Ebifaananyi eby’omu kitundu bikozesa folda ya Diffusers enzijuvu, ebitundu bya GGUF/Safetensors ebyawula ne stable-diffusion.cpp, oba obuzito bwa NVFP4 CUDA enzaaliranwa obuwagirwa ne Python. Vidiyo ekozesa Diffusers. CPU/GPU okulonda kwa njawulo ku encoder ne image generator mu yingini ezesigamiziddwa ku bitundu.
creation.autosave: Ebifaananyi ne vidiyo ebiwedde biterekebwa mu ngeri ey’otoma mu folda za Novera ez’enjawulo munda mu folda z’enkola yo ez’Ebifaananyi ne Vidiyo, n’ensengeka zazo ez’omulembe.
creation.autoNote: Auto etegeera okusaba okw’olwatu okukola ebifaananyi oba vidiyo mu Lufalansa n’Olungereza. Bulijjo osobola okulonda ensengeka y'ebifulumizibwa ggwe kennyini.
creation.source: Ekitonde ekiriwo kijja kukozesebwa ng’ekifaananyi ekiyingizibwa.
creation.variantPrompt: Tonda enkyusa empya ey'ekifaananyi kino, ng'okuuma omutwe gwakyo omukulu.
creation.missing: Ekitonde kino kyasengulwa oba tekikyaliwo ku kompyuta eno.
creation.desktopOnly: Okukola ebifaananyi ne vidiyo nga otereka mu ngeri ey’otoma kisangibwa mu nkola ya desktop.
creation.inputUnsupported: Kozesa ekifaananyi kimu ekiwagirwa model erongooseddwa. Okuyingiza vidiyo n'ebifaananyi ebiyingizibwa ebingi tebiwagirwa wano.
creation.animatePrompt: Anima ekifaananyi kino nga okuuma ensonga yaakyo enkulu.
creation.filterNote: Ekifaananyi ne Vidiyo bisengejja ebifulumizibwa ebikoleddwa. Ebikozesebwa mu ngeri ez’enjawulo bisobola okutegeera ebika by’ebiyingizibwa ebiwerako; kino tekitegeeza nti bulijjo basobola okukola ebifaananyi oba vidiyo.
creation.generationOnly: Omuze guno gukola emikutu gy’amawulire. Kironde mu kitundu ky’Ekifaananyi oba Vidiyo.
creation.cloudNote: Okukola ku cloud kusindika ekiragiro kyo n’ekifaananyi ky’oyingizizza eri omuweereza gw’olonze, era kiyinza okukusasulisa. Okuyimiriza ku kyuma kyo kuyinza obutasazaamu ssente ezisoloozebwa omuweereza.
creation.cloudDefaults: Ekire kikozesa ebiteekeddwateekeddwa ebikwata ku muwa. Ebipimo by'ekitundu bikola ku yingini y'okutondawo ey'ekitundu erongooseddwa.
creation.cloudTimeout: Omulimu gw'ekire tegwaggwa mu kiseera ekigere. Kebera embeera yaayo n’omugabi nga tonnatandika mulembe mulala ogusasulwa.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly yeetaaga akabonero k’okuyingira n’akabonero ka kasitoma aka x-api-key mu nteekateeka z’omuwa.
creation.catalogNote: Omuwa ono akozesa olukalala lw’ekyokulabirako olukuumibwa. Okugizza obuggya tekikakasa kisumuluzo oba okuyingira ku akawunti yo. Tewali mulembe gusasulwa gukozesebwa kugezesa biwandiiko.
creation.ggufNote: Londa model ya diffusion, enkoda y’ebiwandiiko ne VAE buli emu ku bwayo. Ku FLUX.2 Klein 4B, kozesa enkoda ya Qwen3-4B ekwatagana, omuli n’enkyusa za GGUF. Fayiro za NVFP4 eziwagirwa zitegekebwa omulundi gumu ne Python ne PyTorch mu cache ennene ey’okukwatagana. Fayiro ezasooka tezikyusibwa. Kyetaaga ekifo ekirala ku disiki ne RAM. Ku Windows, Novera erimu yingini era egiddukanya mu ngeri ey’okwekola. Enkola ey’okwekola ekozesa hardware eriwo. CUDA yeetaaga yingini ezimbiddwa ne CUDA. Distilled Klein etera okukozesa emitendera 4 ne CFG 1. Tewali bipimo bya model biwanulwa.
creation.ggufWrongModel: GGUF eno erimu enkoda y'ebiwandiiko. Kironde mu kifo kya enkoda era olonde ekifaananyi ky’okusaasaana eky’enjawulo mu kifo ky’ebifaananyi.
creation.nativeNote: NVFP4 CUDA ey’obutereevu: ebipimo bya FLUX.2 Klein 4B mu Comfy, enkoda ya Qwen3-4B GGUF ne VAE ya FLUX.2 Safetensors. Kyetaaga Blackwell (RTX 50 oba ekwatagana), Python, CUDA PyTorch n’ebitundu bya NVFP4 eby’okwesalirawo. Ekola kifaananyi okuva mu biwandiiko byokka. Hardware etawagirwa ereeta obubaka bw’ensobi. Londa stable-diffusion.cpp okusobola okukwatagana. Tekozesa cache ya diffusion ya BF16. Novera esoma Qwen butereevu okuva mu fayiro ya GGUF.
creation.deviceNote: Ebitundu bino birina okulonda kw’ebyuma okwetongodde. Auto ekozesa ebikozesebwa ebiriwo; native NVFP4 bulijjo yeetaaga GPU ekwatagana okukola era ekozesa encoding y'ebiwandiiko bya GPU nga VRAM emala ya bwereere. Qwen ku CPU esobola okutaasa VRAM naye nga encoding egenda mpola. Qwen ku GPU ekozesa layer offload. Mu stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto egoberera yingini erongooseddwa; okukaka CUDA kyetaagisa okuzimba CUDA.
creation.totalTimeHint: Obudde bwonna buzingiramu okutikka, okuwandiika enkodi y’ebiwandiiko, okukola, ekire kyonna ekirindirira, okuwanula n’okutereka. Omulembe gwokka gulagibwa okwawukana nga yingini eguloopa.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: Okukola GPU, okuwandiika enkodi ya Qwen3-4B ku CPU, 4 emitendera, CFG 1. Yagezeseddwa ku Windows nga eriko Vulkan; sipiidi n’okukwatagana bisinziira ku hardware yo.
creation.seedNote: Ebifaananyi eby'omu kitundu byokka. Geraageranya ne model y’emu n’ensengeka y’emu.
creation.imageResolutionMax: Okusalawo okusinga obunene mu Novera: 2048 × 2048 px. Okujjukira okumala kwetaagisa.
creation.upscaleNote: Oluvannyuma lw’okuzaala. Kyetaaga Python/PyTorch. Ebisinga okufuluma: ×2 4096 × 4096, ×4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Okuteekateeka n’okukakasa ebitundu ebyetaagisa eby’omu kitundu mu Novera · Configurations.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Okukyusa omugerageranyo kikyusa okusalawo okuliwo kati. Ebipimo bikozesa emirundi gya 16, okutuuka ku 2048 px.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: Obuzito bwa NVFP4 obw'okwesalirawo ku NVIDIA Blackwell GPU ezuuliddwa oba empya nga waakiri 4.5 GiB ya VRAM. Okukozesa obuzito buno mu Novera, etterekero ly’ekyokulabirako erijjuvu lirina okusooka okukyusibwa okudda mu NVFP4 GGUF ekwatagana era n’ekakasibwa. Okukyusa kuno tekunnaba kukakasibwa ku kifo kino eky’okukebera. Fayiro ya Safetensors eyungiddwako tesobola kutikkibwa butereevu yingini ezimbiddwamu. Q8_0 esigala nga kye kiteeso ekyetegefu okukozesebwa. Ebyetaago by’okujjukira nabyo bisinziira ku buwanvu bw’ensonga.
creation.setupOmniNote: Ekisookerwako ku desktop ne mobile. Omuze omutono ogw'ebiwandiiko, ebifaananyi n'amaloboozi, nga okozesa fayiro eyeetaagisa {{projector}}. Download: ebikwata ku {{size}} ku fayiro zombi. Londako ku nteekateeka ya multimodal etali ya maanyi. Ebintu ebikozesebwa mu ddoboozi bisinziira ku pulatifomu ne yingini. Ensonga empanvu ekozesa okujjukira okusingawo.

creationInstall.background: Osobola okusigala ng'onyumya n'okukola ebifaananyi oba vidiyo nga owanula. Goberera enkulaakulana ng’okozesa akabonero ka main-bar.
creationInstall.engine: Yingini ezimbiddwamu: CUDA ya otomatiki / Vulkan / CPU
creationInstall.note: Okukola GPU, okuwandiika enkodi ya Qwen3-4B ku CPU, 4 emitendera, CFG 1. Yagezeseddwa ku Windows nga eriko Vulkan; sipiidi n’okukwatagana bisinziira ku hardware yo.
creationInstall.error: Okuteeka kulemereddwa. Kebera omukutu gwo, ekifo eky’obwereere, eddembe ly’okuyingira ne layisinsi za model, olwo oddemu.

memory.title: Ekijjukizo ky’ekyokulabirako eky’omu kitundu
memory.autoNote: Atikka ebika ku bwetaavu era n’afulumya ebika ebitakozesebwa oluvannyuma lw’emirimu egy’amaanyi okuggwa.
memory.manualNote: Ebiwandiiko, ekifaananyi ne vidiyo bisobola okutambulira awamu mu mboozi ez’enjawulo singa RAM/VRAM ekkiriza. Models ziyinza okuggwaamu memory.
memory.preserve: Fayiro n’emboozi bikuumibwa; models ziddamu okutikka nga kyetaagisa. Enkyukakyuka zikwata ku kusaba okupya.
memory.failed: Okulongoosa okujjukira kulemereddwa. Ddamu gezaako oba londa Manual.

sharing.imageHint: Okukyusa ebifaananyi kukozesa fuleemu esirifu. SVG eyingiza ekifaananyi kya raster; ICO ekoma ku 256 px.
sharing.videoHint: Kozesa HTML oba ZIP okukuuma okuzannya vidiyo ne fayiro ezasooka.
sharing.fallback: Okugabana enkola tekuliiwo wano ku nkola eno. Teeka oba okukuba fayiro.
sharing.tooLarge: Ekifulumizibwa ebweru w’eggwanga kinene nnyo. Londa ebintu ebitono oba gabana emikutu egy’olubereberye.
sharing.failed: Tesobola kumaliriza kufulumya oba kugabana. Kebera fayiro era ogezeeko enkola endala.
sharing.localHint: Weekenneenye ebirimu ebirondeddwa nga tonnaba kugabana. Tewali nkolagana ya lukale etondebwawo.
sharing.linuxHint: Linux eggulawo enkola yo eya email n'ekintu ekigattibwako. Tewali kintu kyonna kisindikibwa mu ngeri ya otomatiki.

instructions.textDefault: Oli Novera. Ddamu bulungi, mu butuufu era mu bufunze mu lulimi lw’omukozesa. Goberera ebiziyiza byabwe, kakasa ensonga enkulu bwe kiba kisoboka era yogera obutali bukakafu. Toyiiyangako nsonda, bivaamu oba ebikolwa ebiwedde.
instructions.imageDefault: Goberera omulamwa ogusabiddwa, sitayiro ne fuleemu. Kozesa ensengeka entegeerekeka, amataala agakwatagana n’ebintu ebirungi. Okukuuma endagamuntu ezijuliziddwa; weewale okukyusakyusa n’ebintu ebitayagalwa. Yongera ebiwandiiko nga bisabiddwa byokka.
instructions.videoDefault: Goberera ensonga, sitayiro n'obudde bw'osabye. Kuuma ebintu, ebintu n’amataala nga bikwatagana mu fuleemu. Kozesa entambula ennungi n’omulimu gwa kkamera ogufugibwa. Weewale okuwuuma, okukyusakyusa n’ebiwandiiko ebitasabiddwa.
